explanation: Suomi is the Finnish name for Finland, and Finnish speakers call their language suomi too. Neighbouring Estonians call Finland Soome, while Finns call Estonia Viro.

claims.text: Finland's name in Finnish is Suomi.
Estonia, Hungary and Latvia are not called Suomi in their own languages; their own names are Eesti, Magyarország and Latvija.
Finnish speakers call their language suomi.
In Estonian Finland is called Soome, and in Finnish Estonia is called Viro.
